written_by: Claude Code, for Ryan Saleh to check
notes: Sociology for Explore (spec 21), batch 2. Every name and description is in Stackd's own words; nothing is copied from UC's page. C-ID numbers, the template number and revision, the degree name, the unit totals and the campus major names are copied exactly. UC pathway: the Sociology Transfer Pathway page on admission.universityofcalifornia.edu (it states no term or year; academic_year is the year it was checked). TMC: template #1003, the PDF in source_url. A pick-one row lists the template's choices that have a C-ID number; choices with no C-ID number are in its description, because an option must have one. Topics in both pathways (Counts for both): sociology-intro, social-problems, statistics. All 3 of UC's courses are in the template. Statistics is shared with one question for the checker, on that row's todo. The electives are Cal State only. Check every row against its source, delete each todo once confirmed, fill in retrieved_at on both pathways, then run: npm run import -- data/raw/explore/sociology.json --dry-run
